equipment_id.description: Unit the window was opened on

origin.description: How the window was started, or promoted to

started_at.description: Format: date-time (UTC instant, e.g. 2026-11-07T13:05:00Z) When the gateway started the window, ISO-8601 UTC

expires_at.description: Format: date-time (UTC instant, e.g. 2026-11-07T13:05:00Z) When the window expires, or expired, unless closed earlier

ended_at.description: Format: date-time (UTC instant, e.g. 2026-11-07T13:05:00Z) When the window ended; null while active

closure_reason.description: Why the window ended; null while active

technician_id.description: Technician attributed to the window; null when unknown

service_request_id.description: Service request the window is linked to; null when unlinked

unlinked.description: Whether no service request is linked to the window

active.description: Whether the window is still open
